$comment: Stage spec: scoping / ROE. DAG entry node. L0-L1 only, no probing. Concrete domain/IP/URL/wildcard seeds must already exist as trusted UI/CLI target rows before this stage; the model reviews but never creates or edits scan scope.
$comment_allowed_tool_types: Business-registry OSINT may identify and review organization units because it does not touch target hosts. It cannot authorize domain/IP/URL targets. manage_targets, DNS, WHOIS, HTTP and port tools are intentionally absent; trusted UI/CLI ingestion owns exact seed creation before Scoping.
$comment_scope_snapshot: When the profile requires target confirmation, the backend loads the current org's trusted pre-stage target snapshot (manual/imported/customer_provided/stage-run-seed/seed/cli sources only); provider/discovered sources are observations and never authorization roots. An empty snapshot is a valid organization-only engagement and does not require an empty scope_review. A non-empty snapshot requires exactly one successful scope_review that exact-matches canonical value + target_type + scope; every persisted review lifecycle in the current operation window is counted, so a later confirmation cannot wash away an earlier edit/rejection. An edited proposal or malformed outer/inner ask_human response cannot mutate scope or pass until trusted intake writes the revised row. Wildcard is a passive strict-child authorization pattern, not an executable asset.
$comment_unit_scope: Red-team subsidiary scope is a two-branch persisted decision. An explicit parent/root-only ask_human choice with context decision=subsidiary_scope completes the branch without discovery, propose_candidates, or an empty unit_review. If subsidiaries may be included, propose_candidates plus one unit_review are both required.
$comment_findings_allowed: Recon/scoping stage: the deliverable is scope confirmation + (optional) subsidiary coverage, NOT vulnerabilities. submit_stage_deliverable drops any findings submitted here and tells the model to put discoveries in claims. Design 2026-06-15-recon-stage-findings-suppression.
$comment_gate_rules: Default (no --include-subsidiaries): scoping is L0 authz-confirmation (no probing), scope claim needs no tool evidence — coverage_complete is a no-op because expected_techniques is empty unless the harness hook dynamically injects GOLISH-INTEL-SUBSIDIARY (Phase 2). The evidence rules below only bite cells the model marks found/checked_empty, so they are inert with zero coverage cells.

on_fail.reason: scoping coverage evidence ids are optional; found cells are resolved from DB/ledger truth when available
